race.comment: EINSTAG (2) resumes after ending his previous campaign with a respectable effort at Toowoomba in December. He has not quite kicked on as expected, but a good break could have been what he needed, and he will have Taylor Marshall in the saddle for his return, which is a strong lead. Can win. ZARIPPA (5) has been racing consistently this campaign, collecting 3 placings from 6 starts, and looks to be edging closer to another victory. He should be right in the finish again. HEADLINE LEGEND (12) resumed with a solid third at Gatton last time out, and he is likely to strip fitter with that run under his belt. Further improvement is expected, making him a genuine each-way chance. MAJESTIC LOUVRE (3) was safely held at Ipswich last start but is capable of much better and he can bounce back in this more suitable assignment, especially if it is wet. BRUTAL GLORY (1) was only fair fresh up for his new trainer Troy Pascoe, but he is expected to be a sharp improver in this.
